# Category Unification (June 2026) — DBA Phase 1

Reference: `.github/agents/plans/food-category-unification-plan.md`
Canonical rules: `Reference` document at project root (D-1 through D-7 + S-020..S-060).

## Key data-layer facts (post-Phase 1)

- The catalog loader (`FoodCatalogLoader._foodFromCatalogMap`) resolves
  the JSON `category` string to a `groupId` FK at load time. `notes` is
  always `null` on freshly-parsed catalog rows. The lookup map is
  case-insensitive and lives in `FoodCatalogLoader._categoryToGroupId`.
- The hardcoded seed `lib/mock/food_catalog_seed.dart` mirrors the JSON
  and is regenerated by `scripts/generate_food_catalog_seed.dart` (run
  via `dart run scripts/generate_food_catalog_seed.dart`).
- The Hive one-shot migration `food_category_groupid_migrated_v1`
  backfills `group_id` on legacy rows in BOTH `_foodsBox` and
  `_foodCatalogBox`. Lookup is built from the live `_foodGroupsBox`
  (user renames are honoured). The library-box path uses a known-
  category-name heuristic so user-typed notes are never stomped.
- A `@visibleForTesting rerunCategoryMigrationForTest()` helper on
  `HiveWorkoutRepository` clears the marker and re-runs the migration
  for tests that need to mutate group state between initialize() and
  the migration.

## Out-of-scope for DBA Phase 1 (belongs to Phase 2+)

- Browse View screen reading `groupId` instead of `notes` (D-1/S-042):
  `lib/features/nutrition/nutrition_screen.dart` still reads
  `f.notes` for the group header. The data layer is ready for it.
- Sodium freeze onto ConsumedFood at log time (D-7/S-044): the
  `ConsumedFood.sodium` field exists in the model, but
  `NutritionState.logConsumedFoodAt` does not yet copy `food.sodium`
  onto the snapshot. Phase 3.
- My Foods lifecycle (D-2/S-030..S-034), single-calories target
  (D-3/S-040), home strip (D-5/S-050..S-055), day-summary helper
  (D-6/S-060): all Phase 2+ UI/State work.
